# Canvas Escape

A simple top‑down endless runner where the player controls a triangle moving forward across an infinite scrolling field of obstacles. The player can steer left/right and jump. The game ends when the triangle collides with an obstacle or falls off the screen.

**Controls**: Arrow keys – left/right to steer, up to jump.
**Lose condition**: Collision with any obstacle.

1: // game.js – Canvas Escape (endless runner)
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800);
7:   const H = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600);
8: 
9:   // player (triangle) state
10:   const player = {
11:     x: W / 2,
12:     y: H - 30,
13:     size: 20,
14:     vy: 0,
15:     onGround: true,
16:   };
17: 
18:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
19:   const JUMP_SPEED = -12;
20: 
21:   // obstacles – simple rectangles
22:   const obstacles = [];
23:   const OBSTACLE_W = 40;
24:   const OBSTACLE_H = 20;
25:   const OBSTACLE_SPEED = 3;
26:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
27:   const OBSTACLE_INTERVAL = 90; // frames
28: 
29:   let gameOver = false;
30: 
31:   // Input handling
32:   const keys = {};
33:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
34:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
35: 
36:   // audio setup
37:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
38:   function playTone(freq, dur) {
39:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
40:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
41:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
42:     osc.type = 'sine';
43:     osc.connect(gain);
44:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
45:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
46:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
47:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
48:     osc.start();
49:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
50:   }
51: 
52:   function reset() {
53:     player.x = W / 2;
54:     player.y = H - 30;
55:     player.vy = 0;
56:     player.onGround = true;
57:     obstacles.length = 0;
58:     obstacleTimer = 0;
59:     gameOver = false;
60:     // resume audio context (required after user gesture)
61:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
62:   }
63: 
64:   function update() {
65:     if (gameOver) return;
66:     // player horizontal movement
67:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) player.x -= 5;
68:     if (keys.ArrowRight) player.x += 5;
69:     // keep within bounds
70:     player.x = Math.max(player.size, Math.min(W - player.size, player.x));
71: 
72:     // jump
73:     if (keys.ArrowUp && player.onGround) {
74:       player.vy = JUMP_SPEED;
75:       player.onGround = false;
76:       playTone(440, 0.1); // jump sound
77:     }
78:     // gravity
79:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
80:     player.y += player.vy;
81:     if (player.y >= H - 30) {
82:       player.y = H - 30;
83:       player.vy = 0;
84:       player.onGround = true;
85:     }
86: 
87:     // obstacles generation
88:     if (obstacleTimer-- <= 0) {
89:       obstacleTimer = OBSTACLE_INTERVAL;
90:       const x = Math.random() * (W - OBSTACLE_W);
91:       obstacles.push({ x, y: -OBSTACLE_H, w: OBSTACLE_W, h: OBSTACLE_H });
92:     }
93:     // move obstacles
94:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
95:       const o = obstacles[i];
96:       o.y += OBSTACLE_SPEED;
97:       // remove off‑screen
98:       if (o.y > H) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
99:     }
100: 
101:     // collision detection (simple AABB against player bounding box)
102:     const pBox = {
103:       left: player.x - player.size,
104:       right: player.x + player.size,
105:       top: player.y - player.size,
106:       bottom: player.y + player.size,
107:     };
108:     for (const o of obstacles) {
109:       if (
110:         pBox.right > o.x &&
111:         pBox.left < o.x + o.w &&
112:         pBox.bottom > o.y &&
113:         pBox.top < o.y + o.h
114:       ) {
115:         gameOver = true;
116:         playTone(200, 0.4); // collision sound
117:         break;
118:       }
119:     }
120:   }
121: 
122: function draw() {
123:     // background gradient sky
124:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
125:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB'); // light blue
126:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#B0E0E6'); // powder blue
127:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
128:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
129: 
130:     // ground strip
131:     ctx.fillStyle = '#4b5320';
132:     ctx.fillRect(0, H - 20, W, 20);
133: 
134:     // player – triangle with gradient fill (shadow)
135:     // shadow
136:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
137:     ctx.beginPath();
138:     ctx.moveTo(player.x + 3, player.y - player.size + 3);
139:     ctx.lineTo(player.x - player.size + 3, player.y + player.size + 3);
140:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.size + 3, player.y + player.size + 3);
141:     ctx.closePath();
142:     ctx.fill();
143:     // gradient triangle
144:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, player.y - player.size, 0, player.y + player.size);
145:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#4fa9ff');
146:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#0b79d0');
147:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
148:     ctx.beginPath();
149:     ctx.moveTo(player.x, player.y - player.size);
150:     ctx.lineTo(player.x - player.size, player.y + player.size);
151:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.size, player.y + player.size);
152:     ctx.closePath();
153:     ctx.fill();
154: 
155:     // obstacles – rounded rectangles with alternating colors
156:     for (let i = 0; i < obstacles.length; i++) {
157:       const o = obstacles[i];
158:       const radius = 4;
159:       ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? '#c33' : '#a52a2a';
160:       ctx.beginPath();
161:       ctx.moveTo(o.x + radius, o.y);
162:       ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w - radius, o.y);
163:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(o.x + o.w, o.y, o.x + o.w, o.y + radius);
164:       ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w, o.y + o.h - radius);
165:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(o.x + o.w, o.y + o.h, o.x + o.w - radius, o.y + o.h);
166:       ctx.lineTo(o.x + radius, o.y + o.h);
167:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(o.x, o.y + o.h, o.x, o.y + o.h - radius);
168:       ctx.lineTo(o.x, o.y + radius);
169:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(o.x, o.y, o.x + radius, o.y);
170:       ctx.closePath();
171:       ctx.fill();
172:     }
173: 
174:     // game over overlay
175:     if (gameOver) {
176:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
177:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
178:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
179:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
180:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
181:       ctx.fillText('Game Over – Press R to Restart', W / 2, H / 2);
182:     }
183:   }
184:     // game over overlay
185:     if (gameOver) {
186:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
187:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
188:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
189:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
190:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
191:       ctx.fillText('Game Over – Press R to Restart', W / 2, H / 2);
192:     }
193:   }
194: 
195:   function loop() {
196:     update();
197:     draw();
198:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
199:   }
200: 
201:   // restart on R key when game over
202:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
203:     if (gameOver && e.key === 'r') reset();
204:   });
205: 
206:   reset();
207:   loop();
208: })();
